**Risk flags:**
- Revenue fell 20.9% from 2023 to 2024  
- Director 2 holds 96.87% of shares  
- Director(s) appointed in the last 6 months: Director 2  

**Overview:**  
Seri Jaya Store Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited retailer of mobile phones and accessories operating in Kuantan, with its registered office in Kuala Lumpur. The company was incorporated on 30 Nov 2006 and is governed by four directors, of whom Director 2 is the dominant shareholder (96.87%). Financially, revenue declined from RM 5.52 million in 2023 to RM 4.37 million in 2024, with profit after tax falling to RM 35,641 and net margin to 0.82 %. All three audited years (2022‑2024) received an unqualified audit opinion, and the firm maintains strong liquidity (current ratio 5.52) but a decreasing interest‑coverage ratio (2.70).
